VENEERPRO-VIPER

Better cutting and a longer blade life 


Our vibration fence keeps the stones easily moving by a single belt, resulting in only one belt needing to be replaced periodically. More cooling water is applied to the cutting area, resulting in a longer blade life.

BRICK
CORNERPRO

  • A versatile low budget saw.
  • Two rows of bricks can be cut at the same time or one row when cutting corners with an optional horizontal blade.
  • Due to independent blade units, 2 blades can be placed behind each other for step cutting very hard bricks at a very efficient speed.
  • One blade can be tilted for miter cutting

About Yonani Industries

Yonani Industries Ltd, specializes in manufacturing cutting stone machines for the natural stone industry and Brick / Blocks industry. Since 1993, we are a global supplier of high quality machines that cater for the needs of the global natural stone industry. Our outstanding after-sales service allows our customers to maximize their production.

Learn More

WHY CHOOSE US

global support

The company’s mission is to provide superior global support solutions to the marble and granite industry. We focus on innovations, designs and close attention to customers needs.

professionals

Qualified personnel and constant further development, guarantee the high standards of the manufactured machinery.

research & development

Yonani Industries invests considerable resources in research and development, in order to improve and expand its product line and manufacturing processes.
